sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Properties"."property_type_code" AS e, AVG((CAST(("Properties"."agreed_selling_price" - "Properties"."vendor_requested_price") AS REAL) / "Properties"."vendor_requested_price")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "Properties" GROUP BY "Properties"."property_type_code"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
